svg.aria-label: Schematic of two chips, not to scale. On the left, a CPU: four big cores, each with a control part (branch prediction, out-of-order execution), its own cache and a small arithmetic unit, and below them a large shared cache; the memory, on the right, joined by a narrow channel. On the right, a GPU: a grid of multiprocessors, each with a thin strip of control and cache and many small arithmetic cells, and a memory joined by a wide channel. Legend: control, cache and arithmetic.
svg.text: a few big cores, one fast thread
thousands of simple cores, thousands of threads
